prior_hypothesis.hypothesis: Train-only equal patient-label class-mean contrasts have 50.2-64.0% of infection-vs-noninfection squared energy in removed normal PCA32 directions. Fixed deletion may discard useful context. Test a small zero-initialized hidden FiLM bypass conditioned on the removed axes; compare identical-capacity zero-context controls. Existing conditioning principle; no claim of global novelty or disease-causal axes.
prior_hypothesis.geometry: Original fit-only standardization and equal-normal-patient PCA32 for four streams; freeze all16 geometries and16 patientplans before allMLPfits. Coordinate deviations=sqrt eigenvalues clamped at.05.
prior_hypothesis.architecture: Original full normal-reference attentionMLP remains the main branch. Before projection, summarize regional coordinates by image mean, project each of four streams onto fitted normalPCA32, divide by fitted normal SD and clip[-5,5], concatenate128coordinates. Linear128->16,GELU,Linear16->512 yields bounded.1*tanh shift and optional bounded.1*tanh multiplicative scale on hidden256 before originaldropout. Readout initiallyzero; adapterinitialized inside fork_rng preserving originalinit/permutation/dropout. Constant controls replace context byzeros but retain identicalparametercount. Sameoriginalrandominit/fulltask/optimizer/seeds;48heads+4fixed.75branch/.25M5fusions,8scores.
prior_hypothesis.selection: Freeze highest originalCVcandidate strictly>M6 withvalidation>=M6; then unusedpatientrepeatconfirmationagainstM6/M5/fixedGaussian withhighermeanF1andpairedpatient95%lowerbound>0against each. Noautomaticexternaltests. Usedrepeatseeds include20280101/20280111.
